sources: Hit structure: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0013_aglina_* (game 1.6). Basic attacks launch projectiles (LaunchProjectile with assignBlackboard, so the projectile hit uses the parent's atk_scale); their damage is in the *_projhit files and logged under those keys. attack4 launches one chr_0013_aglina_attack4_projhit and two chr_0013_aglina_attack4_projhit_2. The battle skill hits directly: 4 pulls (atk_scale_pull) and the explosion, whose damage unit takes atk_scale_explosion through atkCalculation (kit-draft shows it as LITERAL_0). Combo and ultimate: one direct hit each. The battle skill's and ultimate's ability entities (*_abilityrange) only apply buffs (pull, slow, Arts Susceptibility) and deal no damage. Inflictions: the explosion and the ultimate each have a SpellInfliction with inflictionType 3 (Nature; 0 is Heat in Laevatain's files) in their damage frame, listed before the DamageAction.

Frames: DamageAction frames; projectile hits at their launch frame (travel time isn't in the data). durationFrames: the first AllowNextSkillAction window's start (exclusiveFrame where there is none), the convention of the other kits; projectile travel makes the logs too coarse to check it.

Not in the kit: power_attack is a finisher (BreakingAttackCalculation: atk_scale × 0.05 six times, then × 0.7; btl_upload_576da29ffa7a logs 2510 ×5 and 35135, ratio 0.0714 = 0.05 / 0.7), not ATK × key. dash_attack isn't in her skill groups.

Verified (zmdlogs check): fixtures/zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37.json (Rhodagn, P3, basic attack level 1): all 9 basic-attack hits exact. fixtures/zmdlogs-4e5e1390085e.json (Rhodagn, P0, game 1.5): 40 basic-attack hits and 2 combo hits exact; after that fixture's annotated Camille ATK buff (+9.6%), 12 more basic hits, the third combo, the ultimate and the 4 battle-skill pulls are exactly ×1.0960. fixtures/zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json is under Corrosion with unlogged buffs (see the ultimate's note); nothing there is exact.

Skill descriptions (CharGrowthTable + I18nTextTable_EN): battle skill: "When channeling ends, the gravity well implodes to deal Nature DMG and Nature Infliction to enemies in the area of effect." Combo: "COMBO TRIGGER: When an Arts Reaction is applied to an enemy. A quick casting of the Arts that generates a gravity pull, which then deals Nature DMG and forcibly Lifts the target and nearby enemies." Ultimate: "Creates an Anomalous Gravity Field that instantly deals 1 hit of Nature DMG and applies Nature Infliction to enemies caught in the field. Targets in the Anomalous Gravity Field also suffer from Slow and Arts Susceptibility. The effect of Arts Susceptibility is further increased based on the number of active Vulnerability stacks on the target."

Ultimate energy: max 90 (SkillPatchTable costType 0; P4 ×0.85 via skillParamModifier paramType 1). The combo's ObtainCostAction (costType 0, coefficient 1, frame 48 with its DamageAction) grants herself `usp` 10. No RefrainObtainUsp in any of her SkillData or BuffData, so nothing blocks her gain; her basic attacks' ObtainCostActions are costType 1 (SP, `atb`).

Not modelled: the combo's forced Lift (AirborneAction forceAirborne; physical statuses aren't in the state machine; its Physical hit is logged as buff_physical_airborne) and the ultimate field's Slow (SlowAction move_speed_scalar). Talent 1 (Messenger's Song, PotentialTalentEffectTable chr_0013_aglina_talent_1_1/_2, +4%/+7%, P3 +5%: "When fighting in the battlefield, all allied guards, casters, and supporters gain Ultimate Gain Efficiency +{add}"): an aura (buff_chr_0013_aglina_talent_0 → _effectbuff with CheckProfession → _effectbuff_Add, attribute 44 formulaItem 5 `add`) on teammates of three professions. Kit buffs carry only damage zones and the timeline reads Ultimate Gain Efficiency from each operator's stat panel, so this team-wide attribute buff can't be expressed yet; the talent attaches a skill (modifyType 1), which talent conditions don't read either.

buffs.label: Anomalous Gravity Field: Arts Susceptibility
buffs.note: The ultimate spawns its field (SpawnAbilityEntity chr_0013_aglina_ultimate_skill_abilityrange, frame 60 with the hit, duration = the skill's `duration`, 5 s at every level); its aura gives enemies inside buff_chr_0013_aglina_ultimate_skill, which creates buff_chr_0013_aglina_ultimate_spell_vulnerable (VulnerableAction subType 1 → buff_common_affixes_vulnerable_spell: attributes 71–74, Heat/Electric/Cryo/Nature Susceptibility, priority-keyed by rate) for as long as the aura lasts. Its rate (BuffData ModifyDynamicBlackboard chain): FinalRate = spell_vulnerable_rate × (1 + n × spell_vulnerable_perstack), n = the target's Vulnerability stacks; with potential 2 (potential2 = 1) n is first raised by 1 if below 3 and then doubled (P2: "double the Arts Susceptibility increase per Vulnerability stack ... treated as having 1 additional stack"). Modelled: n = 0 without potential 2, i.e. spell_vulnerable_rate (Vulnerability comes from physical statuses, which aren't modelled). Checked against the logs: btl_upload_d9e59d0fb737 (P1, ultimate level 12) logs 0.30 = spell_vulnerable_rate; btl_upload_40d9a3c1da37 (P3, level 10, no Vulnerability source in that team) logs 0.36 = 0.30 × (1 + 2 × 0.1), the P2 formula with n = 0, which this kit can't express (needs a product of two skill values: rate × perstack × potential2; see the report); btl_upload_4e5e1390085e (P0, level 12) logs 0.36 = 0.30 × (1 + 2 × 0.1), consistent with n = 2 Vulnerability stacks (her combo's Lift at 55403 ms and Wulfa's combos at 55289 and 57521 ms came before; the log doesn't record Vulnerability), not verified. Duration: in 40d9 present on hits from the cast (12951 ms) to 18009 ms and gone at 18684 ms, consistent with 5 s plus time stopped during another ultimate's animation; in 4e5e and d9e5 other ultimates' animations and Liino's own Arts Susceptibility overlap the window. In the game the strongest Arts Susceptibility instance counts (priority key rate); the timeline sums kit buffs from different operators.

comboTriggers.note: CharGrowthTable: "COMBO TRIGGER: When an Arts Reaction is applied to an enemy." Any of the four reactions (Combustion, Electrification, Solidification, Corrosion), including forced ones; Arts Bursts (same element) and physical statuses don't count.

skills.label: Battle skill
skills.note: btl_upload_4e5e1390085e (level 12, one cast): pulls 2777, 2777, 3611, 3611 are atk_scale_pull (0.55) ×1.0960 (the fixture's annotated ATK buff), the last two under the logged stagger ×1.3. The explosion 8972 is atk_scale_explosion (1.30) ×1.0960 ×1.0513: its own Nature infliction triggered Corrosion on the logged Heat infliction first (buff_common_natural_triggered at the same time), and Corrosion level 1's initial shred at her Arts Intensity 80.7 is 3.6 × 1.424 = 5.13 points, ×1.0513. So the infliction, and the reaction it causes, come before the hit's damage.

hits.note: Ultimate energy: ObtainCostAction costType 0 `usp` (10 at every level) in the damage frame. Matches with the boundary buffs: the cast triggers her weapon's buff_wpn_funnel_0011_valid (logged as starting at the hit) before the damage. The physical hits logged at the same time (buff_physical_airborne: the Lift it applies; buff_equipsuit_physuit_01: a gear-set proc) aren't kit hits, and Lift isn't modelled.

Her own Arts Susceptibility (the aura's buff_common_affixes_vulnerable_spell, logged as starting at the hit) comes after the hit and doesn't count for it, so the kit applies it after the damage. btl_upload_4e5e1390085e: exact apart from the annotated +9.6% ATK. btl_upload_40d9a3c1da37: exactly ×1.2000, Link at 1 stack (annotated there): buff_common_affixes_combo_trigger from Camille's combo becomes, on her cast, buff_common_affixes_skillimbue_atk, a ComboCalcZone addition (imbue_scale; ×1.5 for battle-skill hits) for that cast's hits only, valued by stack count from the skill-setting key 连击增伤, which isn't in the fetched tables (Talos: ultimate +20/30/40/50%, battle skill +30/45/60/75%). btl_upload_d9e59d0fb737 needs ×1.2689 under Corrosion with no Link logged: Link ×1.2 and Corrosion level 2's initial shred (×1.0567 at Arcane's Arts Intensity 30) give 21651 against 21666, so it's unexplained.
Not yet checked against an in-game value (no logged plunging attack).
